No. 1987/16 – TUESDAY, OCTOBER 04, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: DS/GFG/L&L/5/2014/07.

Land Min’s Ref No.: 4-3/12/2014/UD/239 -A. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section(1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Ninety-five (95) allotments of land in total extent 0.7635 Hectare depicted as lot No.01 to 95 in Preliminary Plan No. Ga. 4195 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the villages of Madawalamulla South and Dangedara East in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 98 of Madawalamulla South and No. 97 D of Dangedara East within the Municipal Council limit of Galle in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle in Galle District of the Southern Province and bounded as follows.

01. Piyasena, No. 496, Hirimbura Road, Kahanduwatta, Galle; Extent: about 0.0031Hectare.
